title: Representation Theory of Linear Lie groups

syllabus.details: Topological groups and their basic properties.
Haar measure on locally compact group(without proof).
Computation of Haar measure for classical groups.
Linear Lie groups and their properties.
Lie algebra of a Linear Lie groups & examples.
Finite dimensional representations, and its derivations.
Representation theory of locally compact groups-Generalities.
Schur’s orthogonality theorem for compact groups.
Unitary dual of SU(2) and SO(3).
